Oleaceae.teaching_caution: Do not teach four petals or exactly two stamens as absolutes; local Fraxinus/Forestiera can be apetalous and Forestiera pubescens can exceed the typical two-stamen pattern.

Onagraceae.key_tie_breaker: Inferior ovary below a hypanthium/floral tube + usually 4-part flower + commonly 4-lobed stigma. Then split classic primrose capsules from former-Gaura hard indehiscent fruits.
teaching_cautions: Do not teach Onagraceae by flower color.
Do not treat radial symmetry or 8 stamens as absolutes.
Do not call every local fruit a dehiscent capsule; sect. Gaura often has hard indehiscent few-seeded capsules.

Anacardiaceae.taxonomy_note: Source-row count includes synonym/duplicate concepts: Rhus trilobata folds into Rhus aromatica var. aromatica; Toxicodendron rydbergii maps to Toxicodendron radicans subsp. rydbergii.
Anacardiaceae.key_tie_breaker: Woody + alternate exstipulate leaves + resinous tissues + small usually 5-merous flowers + superior ovary + drupe. For local genus split: Rhus usually red hairy terminal drupes; Toxicodendron pale axillary drupes, with aerial rootlets in climbing T. radicans.
teaching_cautions: Do not teach 'leaves of three = poison ivy'; Rhus aromatica also has three leaflets.
Do not use sap contact or crushing as an identification test.
Do not double-count Rhus trilobata as a separate current species under the present POWO/FNA treatment.
Keep Toxicodendron radicans subsp. rydbergii pending dedicated local/range review.

Cupressaceae.key_tie_breaker: Juniperus = evergreen scale/awl foliage + fleshy berry-like seed cones; Taxodium = deciduous linear foliage on short shoots + woody globose seed cones. Juniper 'berries' are cones, not fruits.
Cupressaceae.joey_comparison: Taxodium mucronatum video extraction retained for family/reproductive morphology study; current POWO maps that name to Taxodium distichum var. mexicanum.
teaching_cautions: Do not call Juniperus fleshy seed cones berries/fruits in the botanical module.
Do not teach Cupressaceae as always evergreen or scale-leaved; Taxodium is a deciduous linear-leaved exception.
Do not keep Taxodium in separate Taxodiaceae in the current learner.
Keep local Taxodium at species level until dedicated infraspecific review.

Sapindaceae.taxonomy_note: Raw pool includes western-soapberry synonym/typo rows; current POWO accepts Sapindus drummondii, while S. saponaria s.s. remains a separate held range/taxonomy question.
Sapindaceae.key_tie_breaker: Use fruit + leaf arrangement: Acer = opposite + paired samaras; Sapindus = alternate pinnate + translucent drupe-like soapberries; Ungnadia = alternate pinnate + woody 3-valved capsule.
teaching_cautions: Modern Sapindaceae includes Acer; do not rely on older Aceraceae placement.
Do not teach one leaf arrangement or one fruit type as universal.
Do not double-count Sapindus saponaria var./subsp. drummondii separately from S. drummondii.
Exclude cultivated Acer palmatum from native metrics.
Keep S. saponaria sensu stricto on manual taxonomy/range hold.
